notes.title: "Isha's Magic Library" Steam Release Campaign
notes.notes:
Let's post a screenshot of the score screen when clearing the final dungeon "Vurumai" on Twitter
The person with the highest score will receive a 3,000-yen book card in honor of Isha's magic library!

Please post a screenshot of the item organization and result screen when clearing with the hashtag "#イシャ図書".
*If there are multiple people with the same score, priority will be given to those who tweeted earlier.
* We will send you a book card net gift by DM. Can be changed to Amazon gift card
